T=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 10 & 5\end{aligned}].
$$

Which of the following is the image of the triangle shown above under the action of $T?$

authoring.question: q-21058
authoring.value:
To find the image of the triangle under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing all of the vertices of the triangle:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 10 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 5 \\ 10 & 15 & 25\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the image's vertices are $(2,10)$, $(3,15)$, and  $(5,25).$  Notice that all three points lie on the same line.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13993138/assets/bf5987fde11416780a6a599e3952db7319e1c0e859e2439b7df70c5659bc6839.png)
